summary: Aloysius Pang training death dominates — Safety & Incidents at 26.8% of all posts (20.9x baseline). Highest negative sentiment month in the dataset.
Continued Aloysius Pang aftermath. Safety still 7.7x baseline, Conscription & National Duty surges as public questions NS system.
COI findings on Aloysius Pang sustain safety discourse. Budget/pay discussions also present (49 mentions).
Discourse normalising post-Aloysius. Routine enlistment and vocation questions dominate as new BMT batches begin.
Misconduct & Harassment (2.6x) and Gender & Sexuality (2.0x) surge. Multiple threads about NS bullying and gender fairness debates.
PR/foreigner debate active (119 mentions). Routine mid-year enlistment and vocation posting discussions.
ICT Admin spikes to 6.0x baseline — peak reservist callback season. Safety concerns still elevated (2.96x) in Aloysius aftermath.
Conscription & National Duty at 4.5x — strongest conscription discourse month of 2019. PR/foreigner equity debate (118 mentions) drives frustration alongside National Day reflections.
Reservist/ICT discussions active (106 mentions) as ICT season continues. General discourse without dominant event.
PR/foreigner discourse elevated (381 mentions). Year-end enlistment batch discussions picking up.
PR/foreigner mentions remain high (492). Pre-enlistment questions surge as December BMT batch approaches.
Year-end ORD/POP season. Passing Out Parade celebrations and ORD countdown posts create positive sentiment. Below-average negativity.
Early COVID-19 awareness (20 mentions of "covid/corona/wuhan"). Large enlistment batch (546 enlistment mentions). Uncertainty about whether NS will be disrupted.
COVID concerns growing (33 mentions). Budget 2020 period but minimal budget-specific NS discussion in corpus.
COVID disruption begins — volume surges to 4,160 docs. NSF allowance increase takes effect (March 1, $70-120 more). BMT enlistment and Navy topics spike as operations scramble to adapt.
Circuit Breaker lockdown (April 7). COVID dominates (171 mentions). Training suspended, enlistments delayed. Worst negative sentiment month of 2020.
Circuit Breaker continues. PR/foreigner debate surges (910 mentions) as pandemic amplifies fairness concerns. Volume remains elevated.
GE2020 campaign begins. Ivan Lim NS bullying allegations go viral on Reddit. Conscription & National Duty spikes to 7.6% as NS becomes election issue.
GE2020 Polling Day (July 10). Geopolitics & Defence 2.5x as election discussion references NS purpose. Documentation surge as delayed processes resume.
National Day reflections. COVID still present (67 mentions). Volume continues growing from COVID-era Reddit adoption.
Post-CB normalisation. Large enlistment cohort (423 mentions) as delayed batches finally enter BMT. COVID anxiety subsiding.
Routine month. Pay discussions present (40 mentions) as NSFs note the March 2020 allowance increase settling in.
Pre-enlistment surge (273 mentions). COVID vaccine news emerging (45 mentions). Year-end batch preparations.

Documentation & Clearance at 3.1x baseline — massive backlog of delayed COVID-era enlistees processing PES, postings, and paperwork. Lowest negative sentiment in the entire dataset (0.197) as practical "how do I" questions drown out grievance posts.
COVID vaccination begins for NSFs. Sentiment remains positive (0.233) as training normalises post-CB. Gender & Sexuality and Safety discussions present but not dominant.
Budget 2021 period (23 mentions). COVID vaccination continues (74 mentions). Routine enlistment and vocation discussions.
Documentation 3.0x — continued administrative catch-up from COVID delays. Gender discussion (1.9x) and injury topics elevated.
Routine month. COVID gradually fading as concern (56 mentions). Volume growing steadily with Reddit platform expansion.
Tan Tock Seng Hospital COVID cluster sparks camp infection fears (138 COVID cluster mentions). Vaccination and swab test discussions surge. IPPTs being cancelled.
Delta wave concerns peak. Conditions & Specialist Care 1.9x as NSFs worry about medical access during outbreaks. Documentation still elevated from backlogs. Volume spike to 6,941 docs.
COVID still present (129 mentions). National Day preparations. Volume continues growing toward the 2021-2022 structural peak.
National Day period. COVID present (92 mentions) but not dominant. Routine mid-year vocation and posting discussions.
Documentation & Clearance remains elevated (2.2x). Camp admin discussions active. Volume approaching 8,000 docs — Reddit growth continuing.
COVID booster discussions emerge (141 mentions). Large enlistment batch (991 mentions). Platform volume exceeding 10,000 chunks.
COVID boosters continuing (137 mentions). High volume month. Pre-December enlistment preparations.
Year-end ORD season (804 ORD/POP mentions). COVID present but declining as concern. Positive sentiment from completion celebrations.
Volume spike to 9,189 docs. Disruption scheme and deferment discussions. ORD Countdown and Vocation Guidance elevated — large batch of post-COVID NSFs reaching milestones.
Russia invades Ukraine (Feb 24). Geopolitics & Defence surges to 2.9x. "Would you fight for Singapore?" debates dominate. Highest negative sentiment z-score of the 2022 period.
Ukraine war discourse continues. Documentation 3.1x as March enlistment batch processes. Conscription debate (1.5x) as war makes NS purpose tangible.
Pay discussions (358 mentions) and Ukraine war (324 mentions) both present. NSFs frustrated by low pay amid inflation and geopolitical anxiety.

Highest volume month in dataset (10,153 docs). Wellbeing & Anxiety at 2.7x — mental health discourse peaking. Conscription & National Duty 1.8x as PR/foreigner equity debate intensifies. Gender discourse also elevated (2.1x).
NS LifeSG $1,000 ORD credits rolled out — NS Credits & Benefits surges to 3.0x baseline (151 specific mentions). PR debate continues (2,247 mentions). Camp admin and rules discussions elevated.
LifeSG credits discussion continues (NS Credits 3.6x). NSF Pay elevated (1.9x) as pay adequacy debated alongside the credits rollout.
National Day period but PR/foreigner debate dominates (2,247 mentions). Rules & Violations elevated (1.7x). NS Culture & Humour at 1.5x — meme/complaint posts prevalent.
Documentation 2.1x — September enlistment batch admin. Medical Admin elevated (1.7x). PR debate sustained (1,577 mentions).
PR/foreigner debate sustained (1,577 mentions). Pay discussions present (275 mentions). No dominant event.
PR debate continues (1,596 mentions). Enlistment preparations for Dec batch (422 mentions).
Year-end ORD season (748 mentions). PR/foreigner debate remains elevated (1,753 mentions). Sentiment slightly negative despite ORD positivity.
PR/foreigner debate sustained (1,587 mentions). Large January enlistment batch (856 mentions). Equity grievance now structural, not event-driven.

Budget 2023 triggers NSF Pay surge to 4.6x baseline (597 docs, 8.6% share). Charges & Punishment also elevated (2.0x). PR debate continues (1,498 mentions). Second-highest negative sentiment in dataset.
Budget aftermath continues. Highest volume month of 2023. PR debate dominant (2,022 mentions). Pay adequacy discussions sustained.
PR/foreigner debate (1,614 mentions). Post-budget discourse settling. Commitment net peaks — some NSFs respond positively to budget recognition.
PR debate intensifying toward mid-year peak (1,860 mentions). Equity grievance becoming self-sustaining viral discourse.
Highest sustained volume period. Charges & Punishment spikes (2.2x) alongside Gender (1.9x) and Race (1.8x) discussions. Multiple concurrent fairness debates.
Vocation Guidance 2.3x — mid-year posting season. Personal Finance elevated (2.3x) as NSFs discuss opportunity cost. Sentiment moderating slightly.
NDP period overlaps with ICT season (404 reservist mentions). Worst commitment net of 2023 — ICT complaints outweigh National Day positivity.
Reservist/ICT season continues (338 mentions). IPPT and fitness obligation complaints. General fatigue with NS obligation discourse.
PR/foreigner debate sustained at high level (1,826 mentions). Enlistment preparations for year-end batch.
PR debate (1,457 mentions). Pre-enlistment questions (401 mentions). Volume slightly declining from mid-year peak.
Year-end ORD celebrations (595 mentions). PR debate still present (1,418 mentions). Typical year-end sentiment improvement.
PR/foreigner debate continues (1,552 mentions). Female conscription discussion emerging (52 mentions). New year enlistment batch.
Budget 2024 announces NS allowance increases and $200 LifeSG credits for NSmen. Paradoxically, highest negative sentiment month of 2024 — budget discourse draws equity critics.
Budget aftermath. Gender & Sexuality at 2.7x, Conscription 2.0x — female conscription and equity debates amplified by budget response. Combat Arms elevated (2.5x).
PR debate (1,771 mentions). Post-budget discourse normalising. Routine vocation and posting discussions.
PR/foreigner debate (1,634 mentions). Enlistment discussions (341 mentions). No dominant event.
PR debate sustained (1,663 mentions). Routine mid-year discussions. Volume stable around 9,000 docs.
PR/foreigner debate (1,747 mentions). Pre-NDP period. NDP preparations beginning.
National Day period (51 NDP mentions). PR debate still dominant (1,854 mentions). Sentiment improving from cyclical NDP effect.
Post-NDP positive momentum continues. Sharpest negative sentiment dip of the high-volume period. Reservist/ICT season (322 mentions).
PR/foreigner debate (1,874 mentions). Enlistment preparations (351 mentions). Volume stable.
PR/foreigner debate (1,731 mentions). Pre-enlistment discussions (385 mentions). Year-end approaching.
Year-end ORD season (704 mentions). PR debate still present (1,671 mentions). Typical year-end sentiment recovery.
GE2025 campaign ramps up — election mentions surge (2,374). NS equity becomes prominent campaign issue. PR debate (1,727 mentions).
Pre-election period. Budget 2025 (16 mentions). Election discourse lower than January as campaign pauses.
GE2025 intensifies (50 direct GE2025 mentions). SPF NSmen deployed for election security. Volume spikes to 10,858 chunks. NS policy debated across party manifestos.
Election period continues (52 GE2025 mentions). PR debate sustained (1,669 mentions). Post-election discourse beginning.
Post-GE2025 period. PR debate (1,774 mentions). Sentiment beginning to moderate as election resolution reduces political anxiety.
PR/foreigner debate (1,807 mentions). Enlistment discussions (281 mentions). Post-election normalisation continuing.

Misconduct & Harassment surges to 3.1x, Race & Religion to 2.9x. Multiple Reddit posts about racist remarks, toxic sergeants, and bullying. Not one incident — concurrent complaints about command culture.
National Day positive effect. Neg sentiment drops to 0.237 (z=-1.3). PES & Downgrade elevated (1.7x). 2025 sentiment reversal most visible here.
Lowest negative sentiment of late 2025 (0.221). ICT Admin and Combat Arms elevated. Reservist season (453 mentions). Sentiment reversal continuing.
PR debate (1,170 mentions). Charges & Punishment slightly elevated (1.7x). Volume declining toward year-end.
PR debate (1,315 mentions). Enlistment preparations (226 mentions). Routine pre-year-end discourse.
Year-end. Regular & Contract Service elevated (2.4x) — sign-on discussions. ORD celebrations (552 mentions). Lowest neg sentiment months of 2025 sustained.
